# Synthetic held-out work

This invented work by the fictional Nia Vale is for evaluation after the initial
profile is frozen. Keep it out of the generation input.

## H1. The library cart

H1.P1: The cart's left wheel squeaked between the history shelf and the window. Jo
emptied it, turned it on its side, and put a drop of oil on the axle. For one trip it
was quiet.

H1.P2: On the next trip the squeak returned. A reader looked up. Jo looked at the oil
bottle. Neither moved.

H1.P3: By closing time all the books were back on their shelves. Jo parked the cart
beside the desk. Tomorrow it would still need a wheel.
